svg.title: CACER remuneration mechanism decision tree
svg.text: REC established under Art. 31, Legislative Decree 199/2021 · new RES plants ≤ 1 MW each (existing plants admitted
within 30% of community capacity, not incentivised) · injection and withdrawal points under the same primary substation
scheme open until 5 GW of incentivised capacity is reached, and in any case no later than 31 December 2027
Is the municipality hosting the plants below 50,000 inhabitants?
Original threshold in MD 414/2023: 5,000 inhabitants — raised to 50,000 by the 2025 amendment
(2.2 bn € fund · GSE application window 21 Jul – 30 Nov 2025, now closed)
Apply for the grant (≤ 40% of CAPEX)?
BRANCH B · PNRR grant + premium tariff
Grant intensity g ≤ 40% of CAPEX → F = 1.25 · g (max 0.50)
⚠ F is NOT applied to withdrawal points of territorial/local
authorities, religious, third-sector and environmental bodies.
TARIFF PARAMETERS — COMMON TO BOTH BRANCHES
Centre = Lazio, Marche, Tuscany, Umbria, Abruzzo
FC is added outside the min[·] operator:
the resulting tariff may exceed the CAP
TIP_h = { min[ CAP ; TP_base + max(0 ; 180 − Pz_h) ] + FC_zonal } × (1 − F)
€/MWh · hourly (varies with the zonal price Pz) · right granted for 20 years
settlement on metered data in n+1.
All injected energy is sold on
Does annual E_ACI / E_injected exceed ϑ ? (ϑ = 55% branch A · 45% branch B)
Allocated among members according to the REC's
Excess share (premio eccedentario): only to members
other than enterprises, or to social purposes benefiting
the territory where the plants are located.
Sources: Ministerial Decree 414/2023 (CACER Decree), as amended in 2025 · GSE Operating Rules · ARERA Resolution 727/2022/R/eel (TIAD) · Legislative Decree 199/2021
